sloka: तत्र शैल निभा भीमा मन्देहा नाम राक्षसाः ।शैल शृंगेषु लंबन्ते नाना रूपा भयावहाः ॥४-४०-४१॥
transliteration: tatra śaila nibhā bhīmā mandehā nāma rākṣasāḥ ।śaila śṛṁgeṣu laṁbante nānā rūpā bhayāvahāḥ ॥4-40-41॥

translations.english: 'Those demons keep dropping down in water at the time of Sunrise every day, by the power of Gayatri mantras recited by brahmins scorched by the heat of the Sun. Again and again they keep hanging on to the cliffs.
